• Warning — Read this before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and over. Do not give it to children younger than the indicated age.
• This product contains small parts and button batteries. Keep it away from small children to prevent accidental swallowing. There is a choking hazard.
• This product has pointed or sharp parts. Handle and store it carefully to avoid unexpected injury.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• Do not stare at flashing LED lights. They may cause nausea or other discomfort.
• Incorrect battery use may cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• If a button battery is swallowed, or if leaked battery fluid gets into the eye, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash it off with water.
• Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Store them where children cannot reach them.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct +/− polarity.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local municipality’s waste-disposal instructions.

39.translation: Everyone, please watch my power! And please make me your comrade! Here I go!

rows.translation: Everyone, please watch my power! And please make me your comrade! Here I go!

rows.text: よし、ゴーオンジャー!やっぱり俺、シルバーだから･･････でも本家は女の子なんだよな。
rows.translation: Alright, Go-onger! After all, I'm Silver... but the original is a girl.

42.translation: Go-on Gold isn't silver, but he's powerful and cool. Hmm... I'm torn.

rows.text: ゴーオンゴールドは銀じゃないけどパワフルでかっこいいし。うぅん・・・・・・ なやむぅう。
rows.translation: Go-on Gold isn't silver, but he's powerful and cool. Hmm... I'm torn.

44.translation: If only the two of you could transform at the same time, I wouldn't have to worry.

rows.text: いっそのこと、お二人同時に変身できれば悩まずに済むんですけど。
rows.translation: If only the two of you could transform at the same time, I wouldn't have to worry.

rows.translation: The reason doesn't matter! For now — Gokai Change!
